ow12_record.topic: Epstein: official record, the intelligence question, Barak and Thiel ties

claims.text: DOJ/FBI memo released 7 Jul 2025: 'This systematic review revealed no incriminating client list'; 'no credible evidence found that Epstein blackmailed prominent individuals'; 'did not uncover evidence that could predicate an investigation against uncharged third parties'; reaffirmed suicide
Memo said 'no further disclosure would be appropriate or warranted'; released MCC hallway video with about a minute missing

Blanche questioned Maxwell about nine hours on 24–25 Jul 2025 in Tallahassee; DOJ released transcript and audio 22 Aug 2025; Maxwell: 'There was never a list'; Blanche 'not promising to do anything'; prosecutors had earlier charged her with perjury (dropped after 2021 conviction)

Maxwell moved to FPC Bryan, confirmed 1 Aug 2025; convicted 29 Dec 2021, sentenced 28 Jun 2022 to 20 years; Supreme Court declined appeal Oct 2025; invoked Fifth at House Oversight deposition 9 Feb 2026

Robert Maxwell buried in Jerusalem (Nov 1991); President Chaim Herzog and Israeli intelligence figures attended; Shamir delivered eulogy (per Wikipedia; JTA's contemporaneous account has Herzog delivering it)

Daily Beast (9 Jul 2019), citing an anonymous former White House official: Acosta told Trump transition interviewers 'I was told Epstein belonged to intelligence and to leave it alone'; the claim has been denied by Acosta under oath (per Mark Hoffer); theories about Epstein and intelligence promoted by authors such as Whitney Webb

Epstein invested US$40m in Valar-managed funds in 2015 and 2016; Valar declined Reporty pitch 2016; Thiel had about six scheduled meetings with Epstein 2014–16; no record of Thiel visiting his homes or flying on his jet

Barak and Epstein exchanged emails and met more than 30 times 2013–2017; Epstein helped Barak with an Ivory Coast surveillance initiative (2012–14) per House Oversight documents and leaked Barak emails released by Handala, partly corroborated by The Sunday Times
Barak stayed at Epstein's New York apartments several times; says they first met 2003; flew with Epstein twice with wife and guards; denied wrongdoing

EFTA: House 427–1 on 18 Nov 2025; Senate unanimous consent; signed 19 Nov 2025; DOJ partial release 19 Dec 2025; ~3.5m pages 30 Jan 2026; DOJ cited over 6m potentially responsive pages; DOJ OIG compliance review April 2026; Massie introduced EFTA II July 2026
Sum (E.B.) 2015 LP, Epstein money in Carbyne, Barak statements

2008 NPA immunized Epstein, four named and unnamed potential co-conspirators; 30 Jun 2008 pleaded guilty in Palm Beach to two state solicitation counts, 18 months, served 13, released 22 Jul 2009; Marra 2019 ruled NPA violated CVRA, reversed by 11th Circuit 2020; 2020 DOJ OPR found Acosta showed 'poor judgment' but acted within authority

Arrested 6 Jul 2019 at Teterboro; SDNY sex-trafficking charges 8 Jul 2019; died 10 Aug 2019 in Manhattan jail cell, ruled suicide; charges dismissed 29 Aug 2019; Wexner granted Epstein power of attorney July 1991; Maria Farmer complaint to FBI 1996

Yoni Koren, described as an Israeli intelligence officer and former aide to Barak, stayed at Epstein's Manhattan residence several times; Barak commissioned former Israeli intelligence officers to produce technical plans for Ivory Coast monitoring
Axon agreed 6 Nov 2025 to acquire Carbyne for $625m
JTA 1991: President Herzog delivered the eulogy at Robert Maxwell's Mount of Olives burial; PM Shamir attended.
Acosta in House Oversight transcribed interview 19 Sep 2025 denied saying Epstein belonged to intelligence: 'I never made that assertion'.
AP from released DOJ records: a 2025 email from prosecutor Maurene Comey to FBI officials said seized materials contained no evidence implicating anyone other than Epstein and Maxwell.
ToI: Barak's partnership invested $1.5m in Reporty/Carbyne 2015 seed round (plus $300k Economy Ministry).
WSJ (via Ynet): Barak met Epstein about 36 times 2013–2017 per Epstein's calendars.
Al Jazeera: Barak emails published by Handala; Canada's government has linked Handala to Iranian intelligence.
